messages:
nina: Quick alert: Lodestar private cutover dry-run this morning. Several audit bundles (VPCFlow + CloudTrail) are missing from their SIEM ingest. Can infra/sec triage? @omar @paul :mag:

omar: Triage summary: forwarder chain assumes role -> writes SSE-KMS to customer bucket. Replayed a PutObject from our forwarder role and saw kms:GenerateDataKey -> AccessDenied in CloudTrail. Looks like the key policy restricts by aws:RequestTag and blocks our principal. Repro: 

```
aws s3 cp sample.json s3://lodestar-logs-test/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777788889999:key/jkl-321
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation: Access Denied
```

paul: If policy uses aws:RequestTag it's probably a tagging-based guardrails flow. We should avoid changing their org-wide guardrails. Proposed approach: 1) request a one-line explicit Allow for our forwarder role scoped to the key ARN + source S3 ARN 2) include ChangeRequest ID and audit tag 3) test in staging 4) prod roll during window. This keeps their guardrails intact.

jess: Draft minimal policy to add (will tighten to key ARN and actions):

```
{
  "Sid":"AllowLodestarForwarder",
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/log-forwarder"},
  "Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777788889999:key/jkl-321",
  "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"777788889999","aws:SourceArn":"arn:aws:s3:::lodestar-logs-*","aws:RequestTag/ChangeRequest":"CSR-7123"}}
}
```

paul: Good. Security notes: 1) add expiration by implementing a separate short-lived change that includes an "aws:RequestTag/ExpiresAt" enforcement if possible, or at minimum require CSR tag and have a scheduled revert. 2) Confirm Resource is exact key ARN (not "*").

audit-bot: CSR created: CSR-7123 (change window requested: 2h). Ticket: infra/CSR-7123.

omar: I'll deploy to staging with CSR tag in ~25m and run end-to-end tests. ETA for staging green ~45m. If staging fails fallback option is to enable Redwood-managed key temporarily and note to customer.

jess: Draft CS blurb for CSMs: "During pre-cutover validation we detected your KMS policy blocked Redwood's log-forwarder, preventing some audit bundles from reaching your SIEM. We're applying a scoped policy exception in staging for validation and will roll to production in the scheduled maintenance window. If you prefer immediate coverage we can enable a Redwood-managed key temporarily while we validate. We'll update within 3 hours."

paul: Also flag renewal risk: if audit retention gap >24h escalate to AMs/renewals. Add renewal-watch tag to the account.

omar: Staging result: PutObject and GenerateDataKey succeed, CloudTrail shows success. Pushed prod CSR-7123 for change-control with revert scheduled.

audit-bot: Deployment queued: forwarder-prod change CSR-7123. ETA approval queue ~20m.

paul: Approved with conditions: exact key ARN, CSR tag present, scheduled revert after 2 hours unless customer requests permanent change. Proceed during maintenance window.

nina: Maria (CSM) please send the customer note (use draft above) and attach onboarding runbook: https://redwood-internal/onboard/lodestar. Also notify AMs of renewal-watch.

maria: Will send update now and add renewal alert to AM thread. Owner: omar, blocker: resolved-in-staging, next: prod-roll (ETA 2h). :white_check_mark:
